body:
sara: Quick flag: docs PR #7834 shows duplicated items when a retry restarts pagination mid-stream. Happens in Python/TS/Go snippets. Below are repro notes and proposed snippets.

ben: Saw it in local e2e. The TS snippet simply re-requested from start-of-page and re-emitted items. We should illustrate idempotent resume (use server cursor + client dedupe).

maria: I can update the three language examples. Paste the offending snippets and the suggested replacement patterns?

sara: Offending Python example (from docs):
```py
# BAD: will re-yield if retry occurs mid-page
for page in client.list_items_stream(page_size=100):
    for item in page.items:
        yield item
```
Suggested Python pattern: keep last_cursor and a seen_id set; on resume, skip items already returned. Also show prefix caching vs server cursor preference and recommend server cursor when available.

tom: TS: prefer async iterator but add small dedupe helper. Example: `const seen = new Set(); for await (const page of client.streamList()) { for (const it of page.items) if (!seen.has(it.id)) { seen.add(it.id); yield it } }` Add a note about memory growth and TTL cleanup.

lee: Go snippet guidance: wrap the page callback with a `seen` map keyed by stable id or composite key. Keep examples concise; show a short `wrapDeduper(fn)` helper.

maria: I'll draft parallel snippets that follow same semantic pattern: server cursor if the API returns it, else stable ids + dedupe. Include a short paragraph about cost vs correctness (dedupe trades memory for correctness). Recommend small TTL or LRU for really long streams.

sara: Add a small compatibility note: older SDK versions might not surface cursor metadata; provide an explicit fallback snippet using stable ids and idempotent handlers.

ben: For PR checklist: update docs/snippets/python/streaming.md, docs/snippets/typescript/streaming.md, docs/snippets/go/streaming.md, add a unit-test-style snippet that simulates retry mid-page, and request SDK owner review.

ci-bot: CI: snippet-lint OK for changed files, but example-tests reported flaky failure in py-stream-retry. See https://ci.redwood.internal/12034 for logs.

maria: Pushing branch `docs/stream-pagination-dedupe` in ~20m. Will include inline comments about tradeoffs and link to Optimize/Batching guide for caching implications.

ben: If tests flake locally, run runtime with `RUST_LOG=debug` to inspect retry frame boundaries. Test harness should be able to inject a retry at a chosen token index.

tom: Also add short note in examples explaining server-provided cursor semantics vs client offsets: "Prefer server cursor; if unavailable, guard with stable ids and dedupe."

lee: I'll add QA checklist to confirm samples run on hosted and dedicated infra variants. Also include a short perf note: dedupe set size affects memory for high-throughput streams, link to Optimize docs.

maria: Branch pushed and PR updated with checklist. Marked items as WIP and asked @ben/@tom to review once I push final snippets. Also left TODO to extract TS dedupe helper into devex util later.

sara: Thanks — I'll copyedit and merge once SDK owners approve. Closing after merge. :thumbsup:
